title.narrative: Accelerating Innovation and Catalyzing Capacity for Resilience in Africa - FSRP Phase 4

description.narrative: Component 1 (Strengthening agricultural information systems and institutional capacity) will strengthen the data systems and infrastructure on which agriculture innovation is based, while improving the capacity of regional organizations and national partners to use those data and tools to generate, manage, and disseminate innovation. Component 2 (Scaling the use of agriculture innovation) will develop a menu of mechanisms through which public and private actors will deliver innovation to farmers, while improving technical and entrepreneurial skills so agriculture professionals can access job opportunities and continue driving agriculture innovation. Component 3 (Project Management) will support the day-to-day implementation, coordination, supervision, and overall communication and management of project activities.
To scale agriculture innovation in Africa.
